title: 第5章 等会儿跟我去民政局第6章 我们不熟哎你就这么娶了我
lines: 第5章：等会儿跟我去民政局
慕迟曜下车，把安全帽取下来，随手交给身边的人，眉眼低垂，依然是那副漫不经心的样子。
他一抬眼就看到言安希朝他走来，于是站在原地，淡淡的看着她。
言安希一走到他面前，第一句话就是：“我刚刚没有看慕天烨，真的，你的助理可以作证的。”
慕迟曜没有说话，抬眼看着她，目光深沉，像是要把人吸进去似的。
言安希被他看得浑身不自在，抬手摸了摸自己的脸，确定自己脸上没有什么东西，然后又低头看了一眼自己身上，也确定没有任何不对。
可慕迟曜还是这么看着她，把她看透，眼神犀利而意味深长，浑身的气势更是让人不敢直视。
他足足看了她一分钟，最后薄唇微动，朗声说道：“我去换衣服，等会儿跟我去民政局。”
言安希一愣：“去民政局干什么？”
“领证。”
说完这两个字，慕迟曜就去换衣服去了，撇下她一个人站在赛道上，显得孤零零的。
这里本来就已经清过场了，人不多，除了她和慕迟曜，就只剩下……慕天烨了。
慕迟曜刚刚说的那句“领证”，声音不大不小，却足够让在场的人，都清清楚楚的听见。
言安希转头看了慕天烨一眼，发现他正看着慕迟曜往更衣室走去的背影，若有所思的笑着，隐隐有些得意。
察觉到言安希的目光，慕天烨看了过来，顿了顿，然后大步朝她走了过来。
言安希见他走近，连忙往后退了一步。
慕天烨也不在意她的动作，笑得十分开心：“言安希，听到没有，大哥刚刚说了，等会儿带你去民政局领证。我啊，愿赌服输，以后，你就是大哥的女人了。”
“作为一个男人，未婚妻都可以这样让给别人，慕天烨，我真的替你感到丢脸。”
“你难道不应该感谢我，你即将成为慕城最幸福的女人吗？要知道，多少名媛千金削尖了脑袋，大哥都不会多看一眼。”
言安希看着他，忽然也笑了，眉眼弯弯：“是啊，反正我也不想嫁给你。手段这么卑鄙的男人，看着就让人反胃，好在我及时认清了你的真面目。”
“卑鄙又怎么样？各取所需罢了。”慕天烨说，“你又没有付出什么代价，白白的就嫁进了慕家，这对你来说简直是天大的好事。”
“你是不是早就谋划好了一切？那么多比我好看，比我有背景，比我聪明的女人你不要，选了我当你的未婚妻，其实就是在等着这一天吧？”
慕天烨没有回答她的问题，只是说道：“女人啊，还是不要知道的太多比较好。言安希，在大哥面前，尤其要记得谨言慎行。因为你再聪明，一定没有他聪明。”
“你也知道慕迟曜聪明？那你还把我往他身边送？连我都看出来你的居心了，你觉得他会不清楚吗？”
“和你有关系吗？言安希，你管好你自己就行了，要是讨得大哥的欢心了，你这辈子也不用愁钱了。”
言安希听到这句话，心里一动。
是，她不该和慕天烨在这里纠结这些，现在她要讨好的，是慕迟曜！
这个被她当做牛郎睡了一晚，还留下一百零二块小费的男人！能满足她所有的需求！
这么一想，言安希扬起下巴：“既然这样，慕天烨，你现在该用这种口气和我说话吗？再怎么样，你得叫我一声嫂子吧？”
慕天烨现在完全是一副好像吞了一只苍蝇一样，但又不得不咽下去的表情：“言安希，你！”
“我是希望你早点叫顺口，反正以后见到，总是要叫我嫂子的，就当提前练习咯！”
content_en:
Chapter 5: Follow me to the Civil Affairs Bureau later
Mu Chi Yao got out of the car, took off his helmet, and handed it to the person next to him. His eyebrows were lowered, still looking careless.
As soon as he raised his eyes, he saw Yan Anxi walking towards him, so he stood there and looked at her lightly.
As soon as Yan Anxi walked up to him, her first words were: "I didn't look at Mu Tianye just now. Seriously, your assistant can testify."
Mu Chi Yao said nothing and looked up at her with a deep gaze, as if he wanted to suck people in.
Yan Anxi felt uncomfortable looking at him. She raised her hand and touched her face to make sure there was nothing on her face. Then she looked down at herself to make sure there was nothing wrong.
But Mu Chi Yao still looked at her like this, seeing through her, his eyes were sharp and meaningful, and his aura made people dare not look directly at him.
He looked at her for a full minute, and finally moved his thin lips slightly and said loudly: "I'm going to change clothes, and I'll go to the Civil Affairs Bureau with me later."
Yan Anxi was stunned: "Why are you going to the Civil Affairs Bureau?"
"Get the certificate."
After saying these two words, Mu Chi Yao went to change clothes, leaving her standing alone on the track, looking lonely.
The place had already been cleared, and there weren't many people. Apart from her and Mu Chi Yao, the only one left was... Mu Tianye.
The words "get the certificate" that Mu Chi Yao just said were neither loud nor quiet, but enough for everyone present to hear clearly.
Yan Anxi turned her head and glanced at Mu Tianye, and found that he was looking at the back of Mu Chi Yao walking to the locker room, smiling thoughtfully, faintly proud.
Sensing Yan Anxi's gaze, Mu Tianye looked over, paused, and then strode towards her.
Seeing him approaching, Yan Anxi quickly took a step back.
Mu Tianye didn't care about her actions and smiled very happily: "Yan Anxi, did you hear that? Brother just said that I will take you to the Civil Affairs Bureau to get the certificate later. I am willing to admit defeat. From now on, you will be brother's woman."
"As a man, you can give up your fiancée to others like this. Mu Tianye, I am really embarrassed for you."
"Shouldn't you thank me? You are about to become the happiest woman in Mucheng? You know, how many famous ladies have sharpened their heads, but my eldest brother will not take a second look."
Yan Anxi looked at him and suddenly smiled, her eyebrows curved: "Yes, I don't want to marry you anyway. The sight of a man with such despicable methods makes people sick to his stomach. Fortunately, I recognized your true face in time."
"So what if it's despicable? Everyone gets what they want." Mu Tianye said, "You didn't pay any price and you married into the Mu family for nothing. This is a great blessing for you."
"Have you planned everything a long time ago? You don't want so many women who are prettier than me, have better backgrounds than me, and are smarter than me. You chose me to be your fiancée. Are you just waiting for this day?"
Mu Tianye did not answer her question, but just said: "Women, it's better not to know too much. Yan Anxi, in front of elder brother, you must remember to be careful in your words and deeds. Because no matter how smart you are, you will definitely not be as smart as him."
"You also know that Mu Chi Yao is smart? Then you still send me to him? Even I can see your intentions. Do you think he won't be clear about it?"
"Does it have anything to do with you? Yan Anxi, just take care of yourself. If you can please your elder brother, you won't have to worry about money in this life."
Yan Anxi's heart moved when she heard this.
Yes, she shouldn't be struggling with Mu Tianye here. The one she wants to please now is Mu Chi Yao!
This man she slept with as a cowherd for one night and left a tip of 102 yuan! Can meet all her needs!
Thinking of this, Yan Anxi raised her chin: "In this case, Mu Tianye, should you talk to me in this tone now? No matter what, you have to call me sister-in-law, right?"
Mu Tianye now had an expression as if he had swallowed a fly but had to swallow it: "Yan Anxi, you!"
"I hope you will call me Shunkou soon. Anyway, you will always call me sister-in-law when we see you in the future, so just practice it in advance!"
